NCCL-17 : Enqueue Refactor for CUDA Graphs
Requirements

$CONTENTS

Project Context and Purpose

The launch system needed a rewrite to support CUDA graphs in the following ways:

  • Bugfix: support mixing of outstanding graph captured NCCL ops with uncaptured ops.
  • Bugfix: support mixing of outstanding graph captured ops of multiple graphs on multiple streams.
  • Perf boost: Allocating persistent device memory associated with a graph to hold ncclWork structs so that the work need not be uploaded through the host memory fifo each time.
  • Perf boost: Eliminate the host callback graph nodes when possible.
